title: A bin's count follows the filter

# A bin's count follows the filter

South is read with its own rows: the bars of 3, 2 and 1 stand over readouts of 3, 2 and 1. A value of 9.996 shows as "10" at three digits, yet lies in the first bin.

```chart
type: histogram
title: Values by region on fixed edges
data:
  inline:
    - {region: North, v: 1}
    - {region: North, v: 2}
    - {region: North, v: 9.996}
    - {region: North, v: 11}
    - {region: North, v: 30}
    - {region: South, v: 1}
    - {region: South, v: 2}
    - {region: South, v: 9.996}
    - {region: South, v: 11}
    - {region: South, v: 12}
    - {region: South, v: 25}
encoding: {x: v}
binning: {edges: [0, 10, 20, 30]}
controls:
  - kind: filter
    id: region
    field: region
    label: Region
    options: [North, South]
    initial: North
```
